0.name: H
0.text: By the way, I wanted to ask you something.

1.name: H
1.text: I couldn’t help but notice you looking at me weird sometimes.

2.name: H
2.text: I wanted to make sure I’m not making you uncomfortable, and I ask you to tell me if it’s anything I can fix.

6.name: H
6.text: ... Maybe it’s better if I don’t even ask about how you know that.

7.name: H
7.text: Well, no point in lying, I suppose.

8.name: H
8.text: A little over 10 years ago, it happened.

9.name: H
9.text: I was... drinking. I’ve always liked drinking with my buddies from work, made me feel free.

10.name: H
10.text: But then, I needed to get home, and I insisted I was fine to drive.

11.name: H
11.text: ...The car crashed, everything was spinning and blurry, and there was blood.

12.name: H
12.text: I killed a person. A young man, recently a dad.

13.name: H
13.text: I went to the hospital with just a few cuts and bruises while a family lost their father.

14.name: H
14.text: then, because of that, my wife and my daughter abandoned me.

15.name: H
15.text: Yes, I know. Weird to know that me of all people would have a kid.

16.name: H
16.text: She was a beautiful thing, last I saw her. Around your age, I think.

20.name: H
20.text: About what could have happened better, and why it didn’t.

23.name: H
23.text: What good is mulling it over going to do?

24.name: H
24.text: You’re responsible for your own actions, so I’m going to do everything in my power to make up for at least a little bit of my terrible actions.

26.name: H
26.text: It’s best that I go now.

27.name: H
27.text: Keep up the good work as always! Goodbye!
